thread:
Ravi Kapoor: quick sync about the operator <-> control-plane handshake for dedicated GPU pool intents. saw a race in staging where two operators briefly thought they had the same intent.
Ana Morales: ouch. root cause? both claimed before the apiserver annotation landed?
Ravi Kapoor: exactly. control-plane wrote Pool.annotation=intent:abc, but due to slow apiserver replication operator A read old rv and tried to claim. operator B saw updated annotation a moment later and also claimed because it didn't observe operator A's ephemeral Lease yet.
Liam O'Neill: do we have leader-election on operators per region? we do, but it doesn't help cross-shard apiserver racy reads.
Priya Desai: two high-level options: (1) strong single-claim path using a LeaseClaim CRD with server-side single-creator enforcement, or (2) optimistic fast-path with short-lived reservations + reconciliation to resolve conflicts.
Ravi Kapoor: proposal: combine both. Fast-path for small single-node claims: operator performs a patch CAS on Pool.annotation with expected resourceVersion, then locally reserves and writes a PoolLease. For larger/multi-node claims or when CAS fails repeatedly, fallback to LeaseClaim CRD which guarantees single-creator semantics.
Ana Morales: how do we detect "CAS fails repeatedly"? add a retry budget like 3 attempts within 500ms then escalate to CRD path?
Liam O'Neill: add jitter to avoid thundering herd. Also track metric lease_cas_retries and lease_claim_fallbacks so we can adjust thresholds.
Priya Desai: semantics for Lease: include intentUID, leaseSeq (monotonic per intent), state enum (PENDING/RESERVED/ACTIVE/REVOKED), and owner/operator-id. Operator must include lastObservedIntentVersion when writing the Lease. Control-plane will only mark intent resolved when it sees a matching ACTIVE lease for the same intentUID and leaseSeq.
Ravi Kapoor: for preemption, control-plane may need to revoke leases. operator must implement graceful revoke: transition PENDING->REVOKE_PENDING (signal pods to drain), then REVOKED, then free nodes. add revoke_ttl so stale revokes are enforced.
Ana Morales: GC rules: prefer removing leases in ORDER: (1) expired RESERVED, (2) REVOKED completed, (3) oldest PENDING. Admin override should be possible via a Pool admin API to force-delete leases with an audit reason.
Liam O'Neill: tracing: include intent.uid in all spans and set baggage with leaseSeq so we can correlate across control-plane, apiserver, operator, node-agent. Metric to add: lease_conflict_resolution_time histogram.
Priya Desai: operator restarts: it must reconcile leases by listing PoolLease objects filtered by owner/operator-id and adopt them only if they are in a non-terminal state and lastHeartbeat < heartbeatThreshold? Hmm adoption semantics risky. Better: operator does not re-adopt other operator's leases; it only reclaims leases marked ABANDONED by GC.
Ravi Kapoor: Agreed. To avoid split-brain, add heartbeat timestamp to Lease. Operator periodically refreshes its own leases. If heartbeat missing for heartbeatTimeout, GC marks ABANDONED and admin can reassign.
Ana Morales: rollout plan: feature-flag the LeaseClaim CRD switch. Step1: implement PoolLease controller + metrics + tracing in staging. Step2: enable CRD fallback in staging for large claims. Step3: run chaos tests (operator restart + apiserver partition). Step4: canary in prod on single low-traffic pool for 24h. Step5: full enable.
Liam O'Neill: what about latency impact? CRD fallback adds ~30-80ms. For 95p latency-sensitive requests we should avoid fallback. Add claim-size threshold config per pool.
Priya Desai: policy: control-plane should annotate intent with claimMode: fast|strong. Default fast for small ephemeral prewarm, strong for reserved long-lived commitments.
Ravi Kapoor: ops knobs: claim_size_threshold, cas_retry_budget, lease_ttl_seconds, heartbeat_interval, heartbeat_timeout. Expose runtime metrics for these and feature flag.
infra-bot: deploy/operator v2.4.0-alpha rolled to staging at 2026-03-22T14:08:00Z :white_check_mark:
Ana Morales: follow-ups: - Priya, draft Lease CRD schema and adoption rules. - Liam, add metrics/traces + dashboards. - Ravi, update RFC with sequence diagram and GC policy.
Liam O'Neill: I'll also add an alert when lease_conflict_rate > 0.5% over 5m.
Priya Desai: I'll prototype revoke flow and admin override CLI this week.
Ravi Kapoor: thanks team — want to minimize full strong path usage, but we need safety for multi-node and long-lived reservations. I'll push the updated RFC after prototypes. :rocket:
